input_policy: All investor-facing fields optional. Keep exact original wording immutable. Ask at most one useful optional question at a time; an interview is not a mandatory questionnaire. Unknown constraints remain unknown. Proposals require user acceptance before changing the working thesis.
decision_policy: Thesis fit, intrinsic quality and price/economics are separate. No invented score or numeric threshold. A source ID or quote occurrence is not entailment. Nonmention cannot refute a real-world condition. A safe generic answer fails usefulness.
source_policy: No live lookup, seller mandate, financing availability or current legal clearance without an actual scoped receipt. Verify material legal/accounting/environmental requirements with current primary sources and qualified specialists.

seller_materials.purpose: Catalog materials provided by the seller or intermediary.
seller_materials.control: Preserve originals, provenance, confidentiality, access rights, and seller representations.

buyer_diligence.purpose: Maintain buyer analyses, requests, independent checks, unresolved issues, decisions, and approvals.
buyer_diligence.control: Separate buyer work product from seller originals; restrict privileged and sensitive information.

post_close.purpose: Maintain authorized operating baselines, transition records, ownership, plans, controls, and KPI history.
post_close.control: Create only after appropriate authorization; do not assume ownership or system access.

model_policy.grading: Only the opposite non-contributor checkpoint may grade; self-checks are debugging only
model_policy.verification: Peer opinion is unverified; source access, semantic competence and runtime qualification need actual evidence
